acceptance: A strict P08 real-inventory schema records datasets, systems, protocol candidates, immutable source identities where known, qualification status, licensing state, and authorization-critical evidence fields
Inventory status is explicit qualified, pending, or blocked and pending/blocked entries require reasons rather than silent omission
Required datasets cannot be marked qualified without verified license status plus immutable split-manifest and leakage-audit SHA-256 digests
Required systems cannot be marked qualified without source/model identity plus real-execution evidence
The inventory requires at least one GAX candidate and at least one comparison system
Final-test access is structurally sealed throughout SG-000013
A deterministic audit emits a canonical inventory digest and sorted blocker list and reports ready_for_authorization=false while mandatory evidence is incomplete
PubMedQA PQA-L, FHIR-AgentBench, MedAgentBench, MedQAbstain, MedMCQA, MedQA, and Med-PRM are recorded with honest source/license/use status rather than assumed compatibility

The existing CLM, Laya, decider, restricted-logit, clinical-encoder, structured-output, GAX, and conditional Jev identities are carried into the paper inventory with real-execution state separated from adapter qualification
Calibration, coverage, ECAL candidate components, FHIR representations, hardware protocol, and multiplicity policy are represented without using final-test labels for selection
CLI inventory auditing is deterministic and does not authorize final-test access

Tests cover sealed state, deterministic digest, blocker ordering, status-reason requirements, qualified dataset/system evidence requirements, required final-test role, protocol constraints, and duplicate IDs
Exact-head GitHub CI runs Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
SG-000013 introduces no real final-test result, model superiority claim, clinical-safety claim, or SOTA claim

minimality.rationale: SG-000012 froze statistical mechanics, but final-test authorization still lacks an honest real dataset/system/protocol inventory. SG-000013 adds only that missing pre-authorization layer and keeps the final test sealed.

requirements: Keep final-test access sealed throughout SG-000013.
Do not ingest or expose final-test labels or final results.
Do not infer third-party data redistribution rights from a repository software license.
Do not call adapter-qualified systems real-model-qualified without execution evidence.
Preserve pending and blocked sources in the inventory with explicit reasons.

unresolved_decisions: Exact final benchmark suite remains unresolved until source terms, acquisition, split manifests, and leakage audits complete.
The GAX paper checkpoint and training seeds remain unresolved until development-only model selection is complete.
Calibration method, ECAL component retention, FHIR representation selection, hardware protocol, and multiplicity family remain unresolved until development evidence is frozen.
Jev remains optional and blocked unless reproducible access and terms permit matched evaluation.

outcome: Create a strict, digest-bound inventory of real P08 dataset, model, and protocol candidates that fails closed on missing qualification evidence while final-test access remains sealed.
rationale: A paper can become irreproducible or biased before model evaluation if dataset rights, split roles, system identities, blocked baselines, calibration policy, and comparison families are decided informally. SG-000013 makes those unresolved dependencies machine-visible before any final-test authorization.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000013 files and return to canonical SG-000012 at merge 4ef48a894481abe9100f89a81970cd299138e98d. No final-test labels, real model weights, or patient data are introduced by this grain.

scope_in: Real dataset/source inventory with licensing and redistribution state
Real GAX/baseline system inventory with execution qualification state
Pending protocol freeze inventory for calibration, ECAL, FHIR, hardware, and multiplicity
Deterministic inventory digest and blocker audit
scope_out: No real model training or inference
No superiority, SOTA, or clinical-safety claim
title: GAX-P08 - Real evaluation inventory and pre-authorization freeze
